title: LIS Transcription
description: Audio transcription project for ground truth labeling
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Listen to the audio and provide an accurate transcription." />
  <Audio name="audio" value="$audio" />
  <TextArea name="transcription" toName="audio" rows="4" placeholder="Enter the transcription here..." />
  <Header value="Transcription Quality" />
  <Choices name="quality" toName="audio" choice="single">
    <Choice value="clean" />
    <Choice value="noisy" />
    <Choice value="poor" />
  </Choices>
</View>
